articles.title_en: Empirical Bayes When Estimation Precision Predicts Parameters
articles.title_cn: 估计精度预测参数时的经验贝叶斯
articles.abstract_en: Gaussian empirical Bayes methods usually maintain a precision independence assumption: The unknown parameters of interest are independent from the known standard errors of the estimates. This assumption is often theoretically questionable and empirically rejected. This paper proposes to model the conditional distribution of the parameter given the standard errors as a flexibly parameterized location‐scale family of distributions, leading to a family of methods that we call close . The close framework unifies and generalizes several proposals under precision dependence. We argue that the most flexible member of the close family is a minimalist and computationally efficient default for accounting for precision dependence. We analyze this method and show that it is competitive in terms of the regret of subsequent decision rules. Empirically, using close leads to sizable gains for selecting high‐mobility Census tracts.
articles.abstract_cn: 高斯经验贝叶斯方法通常保持精度独立假设：感兴趣的未知参数独立于估计的已知标准误差。这一假设在理论上常常受到质疑，在经验上则被拒绝。本文提出将给定标准误差的参数条件分布建模为灵活参数化的位置尺度分布族，从而产生了一系列我们称为 close 的方法。紧密的框架统一并概括了精度依赖性下的几种建议。我们认为，紧密家族中最灵活的成员是考虑精度依赖性的最低限度且计算效率高的默认值。我们分析了这种方法，并表明它在后续决策规则的遗憾方面具有竞争力。根据经验，使用紧密的关系可以在选择高流动性的人口普查区域方面带来可观的收益。

articles.title_en: Firm Accommodation After Workplace Disability: Labor Market Impacts and Implications for Subsidy Design
articles.title_cn: 工作场所残疾后的公司住宿：劳动力市场的影响和补贴设计的含义
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the labor market impacts of firm accommodation decisions after workplace disability and assesses implications for the design of firm subsidies. We leverage a workers' compensation (WC) program in Oregon that provides wage subsidies to firms for accommodating workers with workplace disabilities. Leveraging rich administrative data and a policy change to the wage subsidy, we show that accommodation rates respond to the subsidy rate and that receipt of accommodation leads to a significant increase in employment and earnings a year later. To explore welfare implications, we develop and estimate a frictional labor market model of accommodation as a form of human capital investment. Worker turnover and imperfect experience rating in WC lead to underaccommodation and inefficient labor market outcomes after workplace disability. Counterfactual simulations show that subsidizing accommodation not only improves long‐run labor market outcomes of workers experiencing work‐related disability but also yields welfare gains for most workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了工作场所残疾后企业便利决策对劳动力市场的影响，并评估了对企业补贴设计的影响。我们利用俄勒冈州的工人补偿 (WC) 计划，该计划为安置残疾工人的公司提供工资补贴。利用丰富的行政数据和工资补贴政策的变化，我们发现住宿率对补贴率做出反应，并且获得住宿会导致一年后就业和收入的显着增加。为了探索福利影响，我们开发并估计了作为人力资本投资形式的摩擦劳动力市场模型。 WC 中的工人流动率和不完善的经验评级导致工作场所残疾后的适应不足和低效的劳动力市场结果。反事实模拟表明，补贴住宿不仅可以改善因工作而残疾的工人的长期劳动力市场结果，而且还可以为大多数工人带来福利收益。

articles.title_en: Dynamic Incentives in Incompletely Specified Environments
articles.title_cn: 不完全指定环境中的动态激励
articles.abstract_en: Consider a repeated interaction where it is unknown which of various stage games will be played each period. This framework separates the basic logic of intertemporal incentives from the requirement that any given strategy profile yields a well‐defined payoff vector. A natural solution concept is ex post perfect equilibrium: strategies must form a subgame‐perfect equilibrium for any realization of the sequence of stage games. When there is one long‐run player and others are short‐run, and public randomization is available, we can adapt the standard recursive approach to determine the maximum feasible gap between reward and punishment for the long‐run player. This allows us to identify which actions can be played in equilibrium and, assuming perfect monitoring, to fully characterize what outcome paths can arise. With multiple long‐run players or no public randomization, the approach fails; a diagnostic of this failure is that optimal penal codes may no longer exist.
articles.abstract_cn: 考虑一个重复的交互，其中每个阶段将进行各种阶段游戏中的哪一个是未知的。该框架将跨期激励的基本逻辑与任何给定策略配置文件产生明确定义的收益向量的要求分开。一个自然的解决方案概念是事后完美均衡：策略必须为阶段博弈序列的任何实现形成子博弈完美均衡。当存在一长期玩家而其他玩家是短期玩家时，并且公共随机化可用，我们可以采用标准递归方法来确定长期玩家奖励和惩罚之间的最大可行差距。这使我们能够确定哪些行动可以在均衡状态下进行，并假设完美的监控，能够充分描述可能出现的结果路径。对于多个长期参与者或没有公共随机化，该方法会失败；这种失败的一个诊断是，最佳刑法可能不再存在。

articles.title_cn: 细粒度设置的空间经济学
articles.abstract_en: We examine the application of quantitative spatial models to the growing body of fine spatial data used to study local economic outcomes. In granular settings in which people choose from a large set of potential residence‐workplace pairs, observed outcomes in part reflect idiosyncratic choices. Using analytical examples, Monte Carlo simulations, and event studies of neighborhood employment booms, we demonstrate that calibration procedures that equate observed shares and modeled probabilities perform very poorly in these high‐dimensional settings. Parsimonious specifications of spatial linkages deliver better counterfactual predictions. To quantify the uncertainty about counterfactual outcomes induced by the idiosyncratic component of individuals' decisions, we introduce a quantitative spatial model with a finite number of individuals. Applying this model to Amazon's proposed second headquarters in New York City reveals that its predicted consequences for most neighborhoods vary substantially across realizations of the individual idiosyncrasies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了定量空间模型在用于研究当地经济成果的不断增长的精细空间数据中的应用。在人们从大量潜在的居住-工作场所对中进行选择的细粒度环境中，观察到的结果在一定程度上反映了特殊的选择。使用分析示例、蒙特卡罗模拟和邻里就业繁荣的事件研究，我们证明了将观察到的份额和建模概率等同起来的校准程序在这些高维环境中表现非常差。空间联系的简约规范可以提供更好的反事实预测。为了量化个人决策的特殊成分引起的反事实结果的不确定性，我们引入了具有有限数量个人的定量空间模型。将这一模型应用于亚马逊拟建的纽约市总部表明，其对大多数社区的预测后果因个人特质的实现而有很大差异。

articles.title_en: The Complexity of Multidimensional Learning in Agriculture
articles.title_cn: 农业多维学习的复杂性
articles.abstract_en: Studies on agricultural technology adoption often focus on one input, practice, or package, which is analytically useful, but may overlook the complexities involved with multidimensional learning needed for a lot of agricultural decisions. In Kenya, we study farmers' dynamic learning (from oneself and others) and adoption decisions over six seasons after randomly inviting them to participate in agronomic research trials, comparing different combinations of inputs during three consecutive seasons. As a response to the trials, adoption increases steadily despite the absence of positive profits multiple seasons after exposure to the trials. Know‐how increases rapidly and faster for high skill farmers who experiment the most, at the cost of making new mistakes. The findings are consistent with a theoretical model with multidimensionality of input and practice decisions and differential learning from one's own experience by skills, where complementarities imply that adoption of an input requires finding how to re‐optimize other dimensions, which adds to the cost of adoption.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于农业技术采用的研究通常侧重于一输入、实践或包，这在分析上是有用的，但可能忽视了许多农业决策所需的多维学习所涉及的复杂性。在肯尼亚，我们在随机邀请农民参加农艺研究试验后，研究了六个季节的动态学习（来自自己和他人）和采用决策，比较了三个连续季节的不同投入组合。作为对试验的回应，尽管在试验后的多个季节都没有带来正利润，但采用率却稳步上升。对于进行最多实验的高技能农民来说，专业知识的增长速度越来越快，但代价是犯新的错误。研究结果与具有多维输入和实践决策以及根据一自己的技能经验进行差异化学习的理论模型是一致的，其中互补性意味着采用输入需要找到如何重新优化其他维度，这增加了采用成本。

articles.title_en: Monotonicity and Robust Implementation Under Forward‐Induction Reasoning
articles.title_cn: 正向归纳推理下的单调性和鲁棒性实现
articles.abstract_en: In sequential games, the set of paths consistent with rationality and forward‐induction reasoning may change nonmonotonically when adding transparent restrictions on players' beliefs. Yet, we prove that—in an incomplete‐information environment—predictions become sharper when the restrictions only concern initial beliefs about types. Thus, strong rationalizability for games with payoff uncertainty characterizes the path predictions of forward‐induction reasoning across all possible restrictions on players' hierarchies of exogenous beliefs. With this, we can solve an open problem: the implementation of social choice functions through sequential mechanisms under forward‐induction reasoning—which considerably expands the realm of implementable functions compared with simultaneous mechanisms (Müller (2016))—is indeed robust in the sense of Bergemann and Morris (2009).
articles.abstract_cn: 在顺序博弈中，当对玩家的信念添加透明的限制时，与理性和前向归纳推理一致的路径集可能会发生非单调变化。然而，我们证明，在不完整的信息环境中，当限制仅涉及关于类型的初始信念时，预测会变得更加准确。因此，具有收益不确定性的博弈的强合理性表征了前向归纳推理在对玩家外生信念层次结构的所有可能限制下的路径预测。这样，我们就可以解决一个悬而未决的问题：在前向归纳推理下通过顺序机制实现社会选择函数——与同时机制相比，它大大扩展了可实现函数的范围（Müller (2016)）——在 Bergemann 和 Morris 的意义上确实是稳健的（2009）。

articles.title_en: Food Policy in a Warming World
articles.title_cn: 变暖世界中的粮食政策
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how governments intervene in agricultural markets to reshape the economic consequences of climate extremes. We construct a global dataset of agricultural policies and extreme heat exposure by country and crop since 1980. Extreme heat shocks to domestic production lead to policies that assist consumers by lowering domestic food prices. This effect is persistent, primarily implemented via border policies, and stronger during election years. Shocks to foreign production induce the opposite response: policies that assist producers by raising prices. These findings can be rationalized by a model in which governments use agricultural policy to redistribute among domestic interest groups. Our estimates imply that policy responses shield domestic consumers, while exacerbating losses for domestic producers and foreign consumers. Policy responses have regressive consequences globally, disproportionately harming poor and heat‐exposed countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究政府如何干预农业市场以重塑极端气候的经济后果。自1980以来，我们按国家和作物构建了农业政策和极端高温暴露的全球数据集。对国内生产的极端热冲击导致了通过降低国内食品价格来帮助消费者的政策。这种影响是持久的，主要通过边境政策实现，并且在选举年更为强烈。对外国生产的冲击会引发相反的反应：通过提高价格来帮助生产者的政策。这些发现可以通过政府利用农业政策在国内利益集团之间进行重新分配的模型来合理化。我们的估计表明，政策反应保护了国内消费者，同时加剧了国内生产商和外国消费者的损失。政策应对措施会在全球范围内产生倒退后果，对贫穷国家和受高温影响的国家造成不成比例的伤害。

articles.title_en: Trade and Domestic Distortions: The Case of Informality
articles.title_cn: 贸易和国内扭曲：非正规性案例
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of international trade in the presence of a set of domestic distortions giving rise to informality, a prevalent phenomenon in developing countries. In our quantitative model, the informal sector arises from burdensome taxes and regulations that are imperfectly enforced by the government. In equilibrium, smaller, less productive firms face fewer distortions than larger, more productive ones, potentially leading to substantial misallocation. We show that in settings with a large informal sector, the gains from trade are significantly amplified, as reductions in trade barriers imply a reallocation of resources from initially less distorted to more distorted firms. We confirm findings from earlier reduced‐form studies that the informal sector mitigates the impact of negative labor demand shocks on unemployment. Nonetheless, the informal sector can exacerbate the adverse real income effects of economic downturns, amplifying misallocation. Last, our research sheds light on the relationship between trade openness and cross‐firm wage inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在一系列国内扭曲导致非正规性（发展中国家普遍存在的现象）的情况下国际贸易的影响。在我们的定量模型中，非正规部门源于繁重的税收和政府执行不完善的法规。在均衡状态下，规模较小、生产率较低的企业比较规模较大、生产率较高的企业面临的扭曲更少，这可能导致严重的错配。我们表明，在拥有大量非正规部门的环境中，贸易收益显着放大，因为贸易壁垒的减少意味着资源从最初扭曲程度较低的企业重新分配到扭曲程度较高的企业。我们证实了早期简化研究的结果，即非正规部门减轻了劳动力需求负面冲击对失业的影响。尽管如此，非正规部门可能会加剧经济衰退对实际收入的不利影响，加剧分配不当。最后，我们的研究揭示了贸易开放度与企业间工资不平等之间的关系。

articles.abstract_en: We propose a novel optimal transport‐based version of the Generalized Method of Moment (GMM). Instead of handling overidentification by reweighting the data to satisfy the moment conditions (as in Generalized Empirical Likelihood methods), this method proceeds by allowing for errors in the variables of the least mean‐square magnitude necessary to simultaneously satisfy all moment conditions. This approach, based on the notions of optimal transport and Wasserstein metric, aims to address the problem of assigning a logical interpretation to GMM results even when overidentification tests reject the null, a situation that cannot always be avoided in applications. We illustrate the method by revisiting Duranton, Morrow and Turner's (2014) study of the relationship between a city's exports and the extent of its transportation infrastructure. Our results corroborate theirs under weaker assumptions and provide insight into the error structure of the variables.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的基于最优传输的广义矩法（GMM）。该方法不是通过重新加权数据以满足矩条件（如广义经验似然法）来处理过度识别，而是通过允许同时满足所有矩条件所需的最小均方大小的变量中的误差来进行。这种方法基于最优传输和 Wasserstein 度量的概念，旨在解决为 GMM 结果分配逻辑解释的问题，即使过度识别测试拒绝零值，这种情况在应用中总是无法避免。我们通过重新审视 Duranton、Morrow 和 Turner (2014) 对城市出口与其交通基础设施范围之间关系的研究来说明该方法。我们的结果在较弱的假设下证实了他们的结果，并提供了对变量误差结构的深入了解。

articles.title_en: An Experimental Evaluation of Deferred Acceptance: Evidence From Over 100 Army Officer Labor Markets
articles.title_cn: 延迟接受的实验评估：来自100陆军军官劳动力市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: Internal labor markets are increasingly important for matching workers to jobs within organizations. We present evidence from a randomized trial that compares matching workers to jobs using the deferred acceptance (DA) algorithm to the traditional manager‐directed matching process. Our setting is the U.S. Army's internal labor market, which matches over 14,000 officers to units annually. We find that DA reduces administrative burden and increases match quality as measured by reduced justified envy, increased truthful preference reporting, and officers' and units' preferences over their matches. The overall impact of DA on officer retention and performance in the two years after officers started their new jobs is limited by strategic preference coordination between officers and units. However, DA leads to significant improvements in officer retention and promotions in markets with inexperienced managers. Our findings suggest that cross‐market communication between agents in internal labor markets can attenuate the benefits of strategyproof matching algorithms.
articles.abstract_cn: 内部劳动力市场对于将工人与组织内的工作进行匹配越来越重要。我们提供了一项随机试验的证据，该试验将使用延迟接受 (DA) 算法的工人与工作的匹配与传统的经理指导的匹配过程进行比较。我们的背景是美国陆军的内部劳动力市场，每年将超过 14,000 名军官与部队相匹配。我们发现，DA 减轻了行政负担并提高了比赛质量，具体衡量标准是减少合理的嫉妒、增加真实的偏好报告以及官员和单位对其比赛的偏好。在军官开始新工作后的二年里，发展议程对军官保留和绩效的总体影响受到军官和单位之间战略偏好协调的限制。然而，在管理人员缺乏经验的市场中，DA 可以显着提高管理人员的保留率和晋升率。我们的研究结果表明，内部劳动力市场中的代理人之间的跨市场沟通可能会削弱策略证明匹配算法的好处。

articles.title_en: Optimal Shrinkage Estimation of Fixed Effects in Linear Panel Data Models
articles.title_cn: 线性面板数据模型中固定效应的最优收缩估计
articles.abstract_en: Shrinkage methods are frequently used to improve the precision of least squares estimators of fixed effects. However, widely used shrinkage estimators guarantee improved precision only under strong distributional assumptions. I develop an estimator for the fixed effects that obtains the best possible mean squared error within a class of shrinkage estimators. This class includes conventional shrinkage estimators and the optimality does not require distributional assumptions. The estimator has an intuitive form and is easy to implement. Moreover, the fixed effects are allowed to vary with time and to be serially correlated, in which case the shrinkage optimally incorporates the underlying correlation structure. I also provide a method to forecast fixed effects one period ahead in this setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 收缩方法经常用于提高固定效应的最小二乘估计量的精度。然而，广泛使用的收缩估计器仅在强分布假设下才能保证提高的精度。我开发了一个固定效应估计器，可以在一类收缩估计器中获得最佳的均方误差。此类包括传统的收缩估计器，并且最优性不需要分布假设。该估计器具有直观的形式并且易于实现。此外，允许固定效应随时间变化并连续相关，在这种情况下，收缩最佳地结合了潜在的相关结构。我还提供了一种在这种情况下预测未来固定效应一期的方法。
